summary: Rentify full-stack tested end-to-end. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests passed covering auth (signup->OTP->verify->login, 403-before-verify, duplicate 409), owner dashboard shape+revenue-trend, property/unit CRUD, lease conflicts (occupied 409, tenant-not-found 404), invoices/ledger, tenant dashboard, deposits (deduction persisted), tickets (create+filter+update+comment), expenses CRUD, notifications read-all, Razorpay order creation with LIVE key (no real payment attempted) + bogus signature returns 400, Aadhaar 503 graceful, and owner mark-paid flow. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844) verified: welcome screen, owner login, owner home dashboard (Revenue ₹8,500, Pending Rent, Occupied 1 / Vacant 2 / Total 3, Today's Actions: Rents Due Today, Overdue Rent, Maintenance Requests), Properties tab, Finances tab, More/logout, tenant login, tenant home (All rent paid state - correct since a mark-paid ran), Ledger tab (outstanding visible), Requests tab, ticket creation succeeded, Alerts tab loaded. React Native web deprecation warnings observed (shadow*, pointerEvents) - non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' on RN Web. Not blocking but should be migrated. Reference: any component using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius in /app/frontend/src (theme/styles).
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: likely inside modal/sheet component in /app/frontend/src or /app/frontend/app.

action_items: Optional: Migrate `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` (or platform-guarded) to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Optional: Replace legacy `pointerEvents` prop with `style={{pointerEvents: ...}}` where used.
No functional fixes required - all 26 backend tests + all major frontend flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1005 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth, properties, leases, invoices, payments, tickets, expenses, notifications) for maintainability.
revenue_trend has an unused local `d` on line 658 (dead code) but bucket logic still works correctly.
GET /api/properties/{pid} does not check owner_id ownership - any authenticated user can fetch any property by id (units of others). Consider restricting to owner or tenant with active lease.
PATCH /api/tickets/{tid} appends a comment but does not require comment or status to be present; empty PATCH silently updates updated_at only - acceptable but could return 400 on empty body.
Razorpay LIVE keys are in .env; ensure production deployment uses secrets manager, not repo/.env.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (welcome, login, owner dashboard, properties, finances, more/logout, tenant home, ledger, requests, ticket create, alerts)

seed_data_creation: Tests created a few TEST_-prefixed properties, units, expenses (deleted), a maintenance ticket (TEST_UI_leak / TEST_leak), and a signup test user in DB. Existing owner1/tenant1 invoice was marked paid via test_owner_mark_paid_then_ledger - this changes tenant1's outstanding state (currently 'All rent paid'). Main agent may want to run the seed script again or leave as-is for demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_rentify_api.py with shared fixtures in conftest.py. Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Base URL is read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Signup OTP is grep'd from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. Razorpay LIVE - never complete a real payment; only assert order creation returns 200 and verify-payment with bogus signature returns 400. tenant1's rent invoice may be already 'paid' due to prior test run - tenant home showing 'All rent paid' is expected in that case; to re-test pay-rent-btn, create a new invoice by advancing month or manually inserting.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs identified. Two probe failures during UI script were test-script issues, not app bugs: (1) `log-expense` testID lives on the Expenses subtab of Finances; my script clicked it while on Invoices tab. (2) `pay-rent-btn` was absent because tenant1's invoice was marked paid earlier by TestMarkPaid; the tenant home correctly renders the 'All rent paid' state instead.
